intro: Gabon is a presidential republic, led by Brice Oligui Nguema since the 2023 coup.

chapters.title: How it works
text: A new constitution in 2024 set a seven-year presidential term. Oligui Nguema won the April 2025 election with about 90% of the vote.

chapters.title: Nature policy
text: Gabon was the first African country to be paid for protecting its forests' carbon.

keyTerms.meaning: A seizure of power by force.
